sections without a CRC are checksummed: the checksum of a long section is not chained
the structure pass of a huge text is not refused
the empty text is not checked
a letter that does not occur is accepted
BUILD_INFO is not checked for UTF-8
SA[0] is not compared with n
LCP[0] and LCP[1] are not checked
a position n at a rank above 0 is accepted
the LCP may be longer than the shorter suffix
adjacent suffixes need not be in order
the first mismatch need not be at the LCP
